failure_modes: Prior outputs kept in context anchor the model regardless of instruction
gloss: Models are only creative when the harness forces variation from outside
invariants: Variation is injected by the {{harness}} before generation
Earlier outputs are not left in context when new ones are requested
mechanism: A model asked to be creative loops after a few dozen outputs and is overconfident about its own creativity. Creativity is instead built from {{randomizer}} sampling scenario dimensions in code, so each generation receives a different script. Asking the model to avoid earlier outputs fails because of {{pink_elephant}}: those outputs remain visible. The variety belongs to the {{harness}}, not to the model.
